Leeds were safely in the hands of Darran Bilton while Notts AC had one of the speediest men of the day with Bruce Raeside at their disposal, but taking the graveyard shift for the Beagles was a far-from-his-best Andy Robinson.

Neil had gone through the finish and was receiving congratulations long before Bruce Raeside and Moumin came up the hill, shoulder to shoulder … and then, just at the end, the Beagle faltered … and Notts had the silver medals.
